name: Credential vault
summary: Secrets live in a vault, not in the agent's environment or context. When a tool call needs a credential, the vault or a broker injects it at call time, so the model only ever handles a reference.
how: Store tokens and passwords in a vault
Agent calls a tool by name, without the secret
Broker fetches and injects the credential for that call
Vault refreshes and revokes tokens centrally
facts: Auth0 Token Vault; 1Password integrations that inject credentials into agent sessions
Secrets stay out of the model, but adds a broker to every call
goodFor: Agents that call many third-party APIs for many users
Rotating and revoking keys without redeploying
watchOut: The broker still acts with the secret, so tool scope matters
Another dependency in the call path
